# Selecting a species
```
cfg = cfg_template()
```

Edit the config.

```
cfg1 = write_configuration(cfg)

cfg2 = read_configuration(scientificname = "Mola mola",
                         version = "v1.00")
                         
identical(cfg1, cfg2)
```

Explore OBIS taxa

```
cfg = fetch_taxon(cfg)
taxon_info = read_taxon(cfg)
browse_taxon(cfg)
```

Fetch observations, select obsbkg, extract env data

```
cfg = cfg |> 
  fetch_observations()
```

Explore observations

```
map_observations(cfg, interval = "month")
plot_observations(cfg, interval = "year")
```

Prep observations and background

```
cfg |>
  select_obs_and_background() |>
  obsbkg_extract_env()
```
  
Explore obsbkg

```
map_obsbkg(cfg, interval = "year")
histogram_obsbkg_env(cfg)
```
